name: Projects
tip: Pick an installed wapp to edit its metadata, or hit + to start a fresh draft. Selection populates the Code, UI, Translations and Settings tabs.

children.name: projects
children.empty: No installed wapps yet. Hit + to start a new draft from scratch.

name: Code
tip: Edit the wapp's main.c. Compile builds it via the bundled wasi-sdk; Install replaces the on-disk archive with the result; Run tests executes tests.wasm against the installed copy.

children.name: source
children.label: source.c
children.tip: Plain C against wapps/hal/geogram_wasm_hal.h. No libc.

children.name: install
children.label: Install
children.tip: Write the compiled wapp to the launcher.

children.name: run-tests
children.label: Run tests
children.tip: Run tests.wasm against the installed copy.

children.name: output
children.label: Compiler output
children.tip: Compiler stdout/stderr plus host-side progress messages.

name: UI
tip: Edit the wapp's screens/home.ui.json directly. JSON is the canonical format; the visual editor lands later.

name: Translations
tip: Edit lang/en.json directly. Keys referenced as @key from the UI get translated at runtime.

name: Settings
tip: Manifest fields written to manifest.json on Install. Title is the launcher label; Name is the folder slug.

children.name: identity
children.tip: These values end up in the generated manifest.json when you click Install.

children.name: wapp_title
children.label: Title
children.tip: Human-readable display name shown in the launcher grid.

children.name: wapp_name
children.label: Name (folder slug)
children.tip: Lowercase, no spaces. Folder slug under wapps/.
